request.prompt:
Goods: Insulated copper power cable, 3 cores 2.5mm2, 450/750V, without connectors
Country of origin: TR

Choose the chapter that covers these goods. Options:
- 74: Copper and articles thereof
    contains 741300: Copper; stranded wire, cables, plaited bands and the like, not electrically insulated
    contains 740829: Copper; wire, of copper alloys (other than copper-zinc base alloys, copper-nickel base alloys or copper-nickel-zinc base alloys)
    contains 741129: Copper; tubes and pipes, of copper alloys (other than copper-zinc, copper-nickel base alloys (cupro-nickel) or copper-nickel-zinc base alloys (nickel-silver))
    contains 740819: Copper; wire, of refined copper, of which the maximum cross-sectional dimension is 6mm or less
    contains 740811: Copper; wire, of refined copper, of which the maximum cross-sectional dimension exceeds 6mm
    contains 740822: Copper; wire, of copper-nickel base alloys (cupro-nickel) or copper-nickel-zinc base alloys (nickel silver)
- 85: Electrical machinery and equipment and parts thereof; sound recorders and reproducers; television image and sound recorders and reproducers, parts and accessories of such articles
    contains 854449: Insulated electric conductors; for a voltage not exceeding 1000 volts, not fitted with connectors
    contains 854442: Insulated electric conductors; for a voltage not exceeding 1000 volts, fitted with connectors
    contains 854419: Insulated electric conductors; winding wire, (of other than copper)
    contains 854411: Insulated electric conductors; winding wire, of copper
    contains 854420: Insulated electric conductors; co-axial cable and other co-axial electric conductors
    contains 854470: Insulated electric conductors; optical fibre cables
    contains 854460: Insulated electric conductors; for a voltage exceeding 1000 volts
    contains 854430: Insulated electric conductors; ignition wiring sets and other wiring sets of a kind used in vehicles, aircraft or ships
    contains 854790: Insulating fittings; (other than of ceramics or plastics), for electrical machines, appliances and equipment, excluding insulators of heading no. 8546
    contains 854720: Insulating fittings; of plastics, for electrical machines, of insulating material only (except minor assembly parts), excluding those of heading no. 8546
    contains 853670: Connectors for optical fibres, optical fibre bundles or cables

    contains 761490: Aluminium; stranded wire, cables, plaited bands and the like, (not electrically insulated), other than steel core

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: Electrically insulated copper cable for under 1000 V without connectors falls under heading 8544 (subheading 854449) in Chapter 85, since Chapter 74 covers only non-insulated copper wire and cable.
